message: Hi, I tried logging in this morning and keep getting a 403 error. My account is arcvault.io/user/jsmith. This started after your update last Tuesday.

classification.rationale: The user reports a 403 error when trying to log in, indicating a product malfunction affecting their account only.

enrichment.core_issue: User cannot log in and receives a 403 error.

summary: The customer reports that they cannot log in to account arcvault.io/user/jsmith, receiving a 403 error since this morning after the update last Tuesday. This is a high‑urgency issue affecting a single user. The Engineering team should investigate the login failure and error code immediately.
